title: Polish Jubilant Pilaf
description: A simple and flavorful pilaf dish using whole wheat and polish ingredients. Perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: Polish Sausage
ingredients.notes: Slice into bite-sized pieces before using

ingredients.name: Jubilant Carrots
ingredients.notes: Peel and chop into bite-sized pieces

instructions: 1. Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add the sliced Polish Sausage and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
3. Remove the sausage from the skillet and set aside.
4. Add the chopped Jubilant Carrots to the skillet and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
5. Add the whole wheat pilaf to the skillet and stir to combine with the carrots.
6. Return the cooked sausage to the skillet and stir to combine.
7. Sprinkle the crispy onions on top of the pilaf mixture.
8. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
10. Garnish with additional crispy onions if desired.
